description: This PHP class 'Screen' defines an entity for mapping to the 'ohrm_screen' database table. It represents a screen within the OrangeHRM system, including properties for ID, name, URL, related module, menu configuration, and associated permissions. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping, indicating that it is part of the data persistence layer of the application.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Entity class representing a screen in the OrangeHRM system with properties for ID, name, URL, module, menu configuration, and permissions, mapped via Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the screen.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the screen.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the screen.

methods.name: getActionUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL action associated with the screen.

methods.name: setActionUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL action for the screen.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the Module entity associated with this screen.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Associates a Module entity with this screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the menu configurator string, if any.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Returns the collection of associated ScreenPermission entities.

methods.name: setScreenPermissions
methods.description: Sets the collection of ScreenPermission entities.
